evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A conceptual distinction asserted as self-evident logic, performing rational-persuasion without addressing an audience or invoking authority.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Supplies a reframe that controls the interpretive frame — the facts are arranged to lead the conclusion, exercising informational control through rational-persuasion.

mints.name: ReframeAsAsset
mints.title: the perspective is the asset you keep
mints.frame: Is the speaker reclassifying what the audience holds — from commodity to asset, from external to owned — to shift where value is seen to reside?
